# Next Level Home Services (PacificFix)

> Premium residential handyman, precision installation, and home repair services serving San Diego County, California.

## Overview
Next Level Home Services (operated under PacificFix by Alex) provides high-standard handyman and residential installation services throughout San Diego County. Founded on an engineering background and meticulous craftsmanship, the service specializes in small-scale home improvements, precision fixture mounting, appliance replacements, sanitary silicone re-caulking, and smart home setups.

All operations strictly comply with California state guidelines for minor home repairs and maintenance (under the $500 CSLB minor work threshold per project).

- **Working Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Sunday: By appointment.

## Core Services Offered

### 1. Electrical & Lighting (Minor Fixture Replacements)
- Chandelier, pendant light, and flush-mount fixture installation
- Recessed LED ultra-thin downlight retrofits
- Under-cabinet kitchen task LED lighting (hardwired and low-voltage)
- Ceiling fan replacement and wall control wiring
- Smart dimmer, designer paddle switch, and USB-duplex outlet installation
- Vanity wall sconce replacements and modern mirror lights

### 2. Plumbing Fixture Replacements & Minor Repairs
- Kitchen faucet and pull-down sprayer replacement
- Bathroom vanity faucet, pop-up drain, and P-trap installation
- InSinkErator and standard garbage disposal installation & replacement
- Waterdrop multi-stage reverse osmosis (RO) under-sink drinking water filtration systems
- Modern one-piece and two-piece toilet replacements & smart bidet seat installations
- Supply angle-stop valve upgrades (quarter-turn ball valves) and braided stainless lines

### 3. Kitchen & Laundry Appliance Installation
- Built-in dishwasher replacement with leak-tested water connections
- Electric radiant, induction, and gas cooktop drop-in installations
- Over-the-range (OTR) microwaves and ductless range hoods
- Built-in wall oven replacements
- Laundry washing machine and electric dryer hookups with new flex ducts and stainless hoses

### 4. Professional Silicone & Caulking
- Bathtub and shower pan perimeter removal of molded silicone and re-caulking
- Kitchen countertop, sink basin, and backsplash waterproof sealing
- Bathroom vanity perimeter and backsplash silicone joints
- High-grade 100% waterproof, mold-resistant silicone sealant applied with clean tooling lines

### 5. TV Wall Mounting & Furniture Assembly
- TV wall mounting from 32" up to 85" on drywall, wood studs, and masonry
- Tilt, ultra-slim flush, and full-motion articulating heavy-duty brackets
- In-wall power extension and low-voltage cable concealment kits (Sanus / Legrand)
- Floating soundbar, media console, and surfboard/floating shelf mounting
- IKEA, Wayfair, and custom furniture assembly

### 6. Smart Home & Everyday Handyman
- Smart thermostats (Google Nest, ecobee, Honeywell Home)
- Video doorbells (Ring, Google Nest Doorbell) with chime transformer checks
- Smart door locks, deadbolts, and keypads
- Motorized curtain tracks and smart blinds
- Interior door hardware, handles, deadbolts, and drywall patch repairs

## Pricing & Estimates Policy
- **Minor Work Compliance:** Specializes in small repairs, replacements, and routine maintenance compliant with California Business and Professions Code Section 7048 ($500 project limit).
- **Estimates:** Free upfront estimates via photo or video through SMS/iMessage or WhatsApp at (206) 730-2055.
- **Pricing Model:** Fair flat-rate per task or transparent hourly rates with no hidden travel fees across San Diego County.

- **Q: How quickly can Alex come out for a job in San Diego?**
  **A:** Same-day or next-day availability is frequently available for urgent repairs. Standard appointments are typically scheduled within 24 to 48 hours.
- **Q: Are estimates free?**
  **A:** Yes. Clients send photos and a brief description of the task via text message at (206) 730-2055 to receive a prompt estimate.
- **Q: What guarantees are provided?**
  **A:** All workmanship is backed by a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Work is tested and verified before job sign-off.
